text: You think the jinn know your future? They didn't even know their own king had died.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, was given what no one else was given. Even the jinn worked for him, by his Lord's permission.
They made for him what he willed: elevated chambers, statues, bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles.
And Allah said: Work, O family of Dawud, in gratitude. And few of My servants are grateful.
Then came the one thing no kingdom can stop.
And when We decreed for him death, nothing indicated to the jinn his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff.
He was still leaning on his staff... and the jinn kept working.
it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.
So when anyone claims to know your future... remember: the jinn could not even see this. Only Allah knows the unseen. Trust Him alone.
